summary: AlembicCore rework completed in commit e1de391993a3d8205ed2654412726d00a8ac4d95 (Remove plan recommendation facts leak). The Plan facts path no longer exposes recommendation/top/order/subset semantics from Core dimension planning: DimensionPlanningAidReport now carries factual selection, informationGatheringSteps, crossDimensionConstraints, lowConfidenceSignals, and unavailableSignals only; recommendedDimensions, dimensionOrder, maxRecommendedDimensions, subsetHints, scaleDecision/maxDimensionsPerDraft, and recommended constraint severity were removed or neutralized. Information-gathering steps are derived from all active dimension facts and matching dynamic signals without top-N slicing or order-as-decision. Cross-dimension non-required relationships use related/required severity, and PlanLedger draft sourceReports may still include planningAids because the report is now fact-only. Prior good CO/P1P2 behavior from fe563ee was preserved: no draftPackage.intent, confirm requires full Agent PlanIntent and rationale, stop-write planning_brief_json handling, read-time generation state projection, and resolvePlanDimensionDefinitions API remain outside this rework change.
